name: volcano
job: Map where new lava went during the NISAR window, through cloud and the long Kamchatka nights
user: Volcano observatories (KVERT) and aviation and hazard teams

labels.source: Sentinel-2 hot spots (NHI_SWIR > 0 with bright B12, within 10 km of the vent, hot on 3+ scenes; Marchese et al. 2019) on 31 scenes, 2026-06-18 to 2026-10-28
labels.notes: Hot spots mark active flows and channels; cooled lobes that were never seen hot through cloud are labelled 'no new lava'

model.name: LightGBM on per-pixel radar change statistics

split: Spatial 5-fold cross-validation over 1.5 km blocks in a 30 km window around the vent
limits: One volcano and one lava field; few independent blocks contain lava, so scores are noisy
Labels mark heat, not the full outline of cooled lava
Snow from October changes backscatter and coherence and can look like change
Ionosphere residuals are larger at this latitude (ASF known issues)
